backend: vLLM 0.25.1, local completions with the original tokenizer and tool syntax
backend_gate: Validate native general tools and visual regression; compare 40 historical development cases against Transformers. Report the LoRA inference precision change explicitly. If service loading or contracts fail, retain the native backend and record the failed service attempt.
selection_split: development only; freeze decision before full test evaluation
tie_break: highest development primary metric, then lower latency
limits: Old 40 tasks are development/calibration only. Previously exposed test sources are not a fresh blind test. Service precision results are not identical to FP32-LoRA Transformers inference. No selection or tuning from full-test outputs.
